**Regime: Risk-premium dominates; yield support is fragile across stretched longs.**

- **GBP & AUD are unwind candidates.** Both sit on extreme carry crowding (97th, 90th percentile) with decoupled yields and fragile fundamentals underpinning rich valuations. GBP's real out-yield (+1.1%) and AUD's stagflation trap make them vol-spike casualties; a reversion would hit hardest here.

- **JPY & CAD are mean-reversion longs.** Both cheap vs. norm with improving fundamentals (+0.26, +0.34 structural). JPY's real-yield stress is offset by risk-premium regime (corr -0.54); CAD's strength is narrow (pure valuation), but entry risk is low.

- **CHF offers narrow but clean inflation play.** Pillar B doing the work; valuation neutral, feasibility high. Tight cross-carry vs. EUR/CHF on a solid real-yield foundation.

- **GBP/AUD the standout short carry.** Both unwind synchronized on vol normalization; AUD especially vulnerable given policy fade (growth soft, inflation flagging) and valuation excess (+2.0 vs. +1.4 AUD stretch).
